Questions de recherche ouvertes

Ces questions sont des lacunes de recherche consignées, pas des conclusions juridiques.

  • Whether Articles 7 and 20 apply to government websites, apps and digital services, or only to the formats and services expressly listed, requires legal review. (AE-LAW29-01)
  • The implementing Cabinet decision and technical standards contemplated by Article 23 are not captured; their content and current status are unresolved. (AE-LAW29-02)
  • The relationship between this 2006 Law, Cabinet Resolution 43/2018 and the 2024 National Digital Accessibility Policy needs a consolidated reading. (AE-LAW29-03)
  • The official English translation and the Arabic text may differ; Arabic prevails and native legal review is outstanding. (AE-LAW29-04)
  • Retrieve national 2022 law and treaty-status evidence; do not infer domestic enforceability from ratification alone. (mena-t02-011)
  • Locate gazetted Arabic law and implementing regulations; do not derive website mandates from secondary summary. (eg-disability-law-10-2018)
  • Obtain 2024 amendment from official gazette, reconcile terminology and superseded provisions. (mena-t02-003)
  • Locate official amendment PDF and establish exact changes. (mena-t02-004)
  • Capture policy and determine accessibility-specific provisions and scope. (jo-digital-inclusion-2025)
  • Retrieve official-gazette text and amendments; distinguish rights from service descriptions. (mena-t02-005)
  • Identify accessibility and implementation provisions and later implementing instruments. (ma-disability-97-13)
  • Confirm applicability to government agencies, technical standards, exemptions and whether later policies supersede the 2022 instrument. (om-national-digital-accessibility)
